title: Gounods Ave Maria what
html_source:
The words to the hymn are as follows:

Hail Maria
Full of grace
The Lord is with thee
Blessed art thou among women
And blessed is the fruit
Of thy womb, Jesus
Holy Maria, Holy Maria
Maria, pray for us
Us sinners
Nou and in the hour
Of our death
Amen.
